response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS st, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin,0)) AS rate, COUNT(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin,0)) AS cnt FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(g.rate - a.overall) AS avg_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.overall IS NOT NULL AND g.rate > a.overall
